reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis relies on selective Cu oxidation and grain refinement from a single 500°C anneal, but Cu is not strongly surface-segregating in this equimolar alloy and concurrent oxidation of Cr, Fe, or Ni is thermodynamically favored, making the proposed selective Cu-rich oxide layer physically questionable.
reasons.testability: The proposed test clearly compares pre-treated vs. as-deposited coatings with specific characterization (SEM, EDS, XRD) and tribological measurements, and defines a falsification criterion based on the absence of the Cu-rich oxide layer and wear improvement.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses a relevant mechanism for high-temperature wear of a coating, but its core premise of selective Cu oxidation is unlikely to succeed, reducing its practical value for guiding experiments.
